frontier_targets.description: Full moduli variety classification: prove every 6×6 CHM belongs to {F₆, B₆(θ), K₆⁽³⁾, S₆, H₆}. This is the irreducible core of Premise G1. Approach: algebraic elimination of the 50-variable / 55-polynomial ideal I(H₆) into its irreducible components, or formalization of Beauchamp-Nicoara + Szöllősi + Karlsson classification results.

Formalize that all known sporadic / non-affine 6×6 CHM classes from the literature (Beauchamp-Nicoara, Szöllősi, Karlsson, Cárdenes Wuttig–Tindall) are either equivalent to the 5 cataloged families or provably empty. Approach: for each literature class, construct an explicit Cyc24 representative and run it through classify_orbit to verify it lands in the catalog.

Extend F₆ external B₃ coverage from 6 locked lattice seeds to the full continuous (x,y) parameter space. Approach: parametric branch-and-bound cover over the 2-torus T², using the existing f6_chart infrastructure to verify that at every (x,y) the external B₃ candidates either are MU or produce a certified obstruction.

Close the gap between recorded δ-patches and full moduli. Currently the atlas covers neighborhoods of known points but not the intervening parameter space. Approach: continuous Szöllősi arc chaining from θ=0 to θ=π with collar-style 2D periodic cover.

Discharge the basis_gluing_gate MissingProofObligation: construct the Ψ_basis bridge from vector wall covers to the basis-extension packet. Approach: for each chart in the moduli atlas, verify that the transition from vector-level MU obstruction to basis-level extension impossibility is algebraically valid.

Prove atlas coherence: multi-patch gluing with transport and ZeroRel preservation. Currently only pairwise disjointness is proven. Approach: verify Čech cocycle condition on all triple intersections and confirm holonomy is identity on all non-contractible loops.

Complete the δ=1/1000 full 5-torus neighborhood cover on Y₂⊗Q₂ three seeds. The Y₂⊗Q₁ orbit point covers are complete; the Y₂⊗Q₂ dual orbit δ-widening was deferred due to wall-time. Approach: run mub6_dita_seed_cover with δ=1/1000 on the 3 Y₂⊗Q₂ seeds.

Path B: rigidity-route obstruction via exact deformation invariance probes at basepoints including Diță second basepoints. Currently Gate A fails on T₀. If Gate A∧B passes anywhere, it would indicate a potential 4th MUB root (Branch B of the Decisive Bifurcation). Approach: extend d6_exact_deformation_invariance_probe to additional basepoints on the Szöllősi arc.

Scale the Lean 4 kernel reflection from pilot JSON to full ~1M cover leaf verification. This is a mechanization gap, not a mathematical gap. Approach: stratified manifest with batch reflection or redesigned certificate shape.

recommended_next_action: Target G1-MASTER: The irreducible core of G1. Two viable approaches: (A) Formalize the Beauchamp-Nicoara / Szöllősi / Karlsson / Cárdenes Wuttig-Tindall classification theorem by constructing explicit Cyc24 representatives for each literature class and proving they exhaust the 50-variable variety. (B) Perform direct algebraic elimination of the 55-polynomial ideal in 50 variables via Gröbner basis computation over Q(zeta_24), decomposing the variety into irreducible components matching the 5 known families.
